title: Seed Companies Say They See the Arable Exodus Coming
description_clean: Seed and grain companies share the concerns of arable farmers about the viability of their sector, says Seed and Grain New Zealand chief executive Dr Sarah Clark. With increasing numbers of arable farmers looking to diversify or even abandon arable altogether to go dairying, Clark said it was not true that the companies were unaware of the exodus facing the sector. “The seed companies have seen that coming, they’re aware of it. summary: Seed and Grain New Zealand chief executive Dr Sarah Clark says seed and grain companies are aware of and share concerns about the arable sector's viability as increasing numbers of farmers look to diversify or move to dairying due to threatened profit margins and rising costs.
